sn35.247:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya.
sn35.247:1.2: tassa kusakaṇṭakā ceva pāde vijjheyyuṃ, sarapattāni ca gattāni vilikheyyuṃ evaṃ
sn35.247:1.3: hi so bhikkhave puriso bhiyyo somattāya tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha.
sn35.247:1.4: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu gāmagato vā araññagato vā labhati vattāraṃ:
sn35.247:1.5: ayañca so āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asuci gāmakaṇṭakoti.
sn35.247:1.6: taṃ kaṇṭakoti iti viditvā saṃvaro ca asaṃvaro ca veditabbo.
sn35.247:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe vyāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso.
sn35.247:2.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.247:2.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme vyāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso
sn35.247:2.9: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.247:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya:
sn35.247:3.8: daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā majjhe gaṇṭhiṃ karitvā ossajjeyya.
sn35.247:3.9: atha kho te bhikkhave chappāṇakā nānā visayā nānā gocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayaṃ āviñcheyyuṃ,
sn35.247:3.10: ahi āviñcheyya vammikaṃ pavekkhāmīti, suṃsumāro āviñcheyya udakaṃ pavekkhāmīti, pakkhī āviñcheyya ākāsaṃ ḍessāmīti, kukkuro āviñcheyya gāmaṃ pavekkhāmīti, sigālo āviñcheyya sīvathikaṃ pavekkhāmīti, makkaṭo āviñcheyya vanaṃ pavekkhāmīti.
sn35.247:3.11: yadā kho te bhikkhave chappāṇakā jhattā assu kilantā, atha yo nesaṃ pāṇako balavataro assa, tassa te anuppavatteyyuṃ, anuvidhāyeyyuṃ, vasaṃ gaccheyyuṃ.
sn35.247:3.12: evameva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpikesu rūpesu, amanāpikassa rūpā paṭikkūlā honti, sotaṃ āviñjati manāpikesu saddesu, amanāpikassa saddā paṭikkūlā honti, ghānaṃ āviñjati manāpikesu gandhesu amanāpikassa gandhā paṭikkūlā honti, jivhā āviñjati manāpikesu rasesu amanāpikassa rasā paṭikkūlā honti, kāyo āviñjati manāpikesu phoṭṭhabbesu, amanāpikassa phoṭṭhabbā paṭikkūlā honti,
sn35.247:3.13: mano āviñchati manāpikesu dhammesu, amanāpikassa dhammā paṭikkūlā honti.
sn35.247:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na vyāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso,
sn35.247:4.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti. sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe…
sn35.247:4.4: ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe… jivhā rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
sn35.247:4.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme na vyāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso,
sn35.247:4.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.247:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānā visaye nānā gocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.
sn35.247:5.8: daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibandheyya.
sn35.247:5.9: atha kho te bhikkhave chappāṇakā nānā visayā nānā gocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayaṃ āviñcheyyuṃ;
sn35.247:5.10: ahi āviñcheyya vammikaṃ pavekkhāmīti, suṃsumāro āviñcheyya udakaṃ pavekkhāmīti, pakkhī āviñcheyya ākāsaṃ ḍessāmīti, kukkuro āviñcheyya gāmaṃ pavekkhāmīti, sigālo āviñcheyya sīvathikaṃ pavekkhāmīti, makkaṭo āviñcheyya vanaṃ pavekkhāmīti.
sn35.247:5.11: yadā kho te bhikkhave chappāṇakā jhattā assu kilantā, atha tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭheyyuṃ, upanisīdeyyuṃ, upanipajjeyyuṃ, vasaṃ gaccheyyuṃ.
sn35.247:5.12: evameva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati bhāvitā bahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu nāviñchati manāpikesu rūpesu, amanāpikassa rūpāni nappaṭikkūlāni honti; sotaṃ nāviñjati …pe… ghānaṃ nāviñjati …pe… jivhā nāviñjati …pe… kāyo nāviñjati …pe…
sn35.247:5.13: mano nāviñjati manāpikesu dhammesu, amanāpissa dhammā nappaṭikūlā honti.
sn35.247:6.1: daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā. ti kho bhikkhave kāyagatā satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.247:6.3: “kāyagatā no sati bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā”ti.
